newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Life says 9-mth revenues surge.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Life says 9-mth revenues surge.

text.p: Indonesian insurance company PT Asuransi Lippo Life said on Monday that revenues in the first nine months of 1996 had surged to 478.4 billion rupiah from 349.4 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
The company said in a statement that investible funds increased 92 percent to 1,124.1 billion rupiah over the year-ago period and total assets rose 91 percent to 1,203.5 billion rupiah.
It said net earnings for the full year are likely to reach 48.8 billion rupiah or 127 rupiah per share, up from 104 rupiah in 1995.
Company president Billy Sindoro said the "impressive results of the third quarter prove that our strategies are right and provide a strong basis for striking year-end results".
